thread:
Ellen R.: Flagging an issue: Oceanic Health (acct 2210) invoices for Apr 2026 show USD amounts but their billing profile currency is EUR. The VAT and FX conversion lines are missing, invoice appears ~€9,120 under what portal shows. Can ops investigate?

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 2026-05-02T07:05:00Z finished with 1 WARN. WARN: 1 invoice(s) generated with mismatched currency metadata. job id job_20260502_0705

Tom H.: Invoice id?

Ellen R.: INV-2026-04-07891 (pdf: https://payments.internal.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-04-07891.pdf) raw: s3://billing-outputs/2026/04/INV-2026-04-07891.json

Nora S.: Pulling raw. I see the line items present but amount_currency = "USD" for all rows and fx_rate is null. Our currency conversion step is supposed to attach fx_rate and compute amount_local. Looks like an upstream service (pricing-exchange) returned 204 for EUR->USD lookup for the day. The generator tolerated missing fx and skipped VAT calculation because it checks currency == account.currency before adding VAT lines.

Nora S.: Snippet from generator logic: if (line.amount_currency !== account.currency) { skip_vat = true; } // this prevented VAT lines when fx lookup failed

Ellen R.: Also found a duplicate invoice draft: INV-2026-04-07891 and INV-2026-04-07891-copy. Both Draft; autopay off. Do not capture.

Tom H.: Quick remediation plan: (1) Make generator resilient - if fx_rate missing, mark invoice "requires-fx" and add provisional VAT line using last-known rate instead of skipping VAT entirely. (2) Re-run invoice generation for account 2210. (3) Void duplicate draft. I'll open a patch.

Nora S.: Opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood/invoice-gen/pulls/221 Adds fallback fx_rate from daily_fx_cache and flag on invoice metadata. Also updates unit tests. Requesting deploy to staging.

Ellen R.: Meanwhile please create an interim credit memo for the estimated VAT + conversion gap so CS can show the customer: amount €9,120.00, reason: "missing VAT due to FX lookup failure". Link to both invoice IDs.

billing-bot: action logged: provisional_credit created PC-2026-05-0027 €9120.00 linked to INV-2026-04-07891 and INV-2026-04-07891-copy by Ellen R. at 2026-05-02T07:24:11Z

Tom H.: Deployed fix to staging and ran smoke. Pushing to prod in 10. Will mark invoices with requires-fx label so ops knows to reprocess.

Nora S.: Deployed to prod at 2026-05-02T07:48:02Z. Reprocess command:
```bash
billing-reprocess --account 2210 --period 2026-04 --mode regenerate --reason "fx/vat missing"
```

billing-bot: job_reproc_2210_202604 started at 2026-05-02T08:02:10Z

billing-bot: job_reproc_2210_202604 completed at 2026-05-02T08:15:34Z. Result: regenerated invoice INV-2026-04-07891-corrected.pdf uploaded s3://billing-outputs/2026/04/INV-2026-04-07891-corrected.pdf. Duplicate draft INV-2026-04-07891-copy voided.

Ellen R.: Verified corrected invoice includes VAT lines and EUR totals. Converted provisional credit PC-2026-05-0027 to official credit memo CM-2026-05-0008 and applied. Notified Oceanic CS with explanation and apology.

Tom H.: Postmortem items added to FIN-4989: add alert for pricing-exchange 204 responses, make invoice-generator set "requires-fx" tag when fx missing, and add reconciliation check comparing invoice currency to account.currency.

Ellen R.: Thanks team. Closing the issue once FIN-4989 tasks are triaged. :thumbsup:
